main_text.p: stica : omnibus item letale virus inten-dit hæresis à Socino nomen ferens ; hoc Papismo perniciosior , quo præcipua, & catholica Christianismi dogmata evertit , quæ etiam Papismus retinet quadantenus, quamvis superstitionibus suis obruta multum & suppressa. Hic autem ultimus videtur Diaboli in Eccle-siam conatus : per Socinianos , fidem ; per dissolutum vivendi genus, pietatem impetere : licentiam ubique & agendi & credendi, sub specie & prætextu fu-nestæ libertatis urgendo , in perniciem fidei pariter & pietatis. Libertati quidem ingeniorum , fateor , aliquid tri-buendum ; nonnihil etiam novitati ; sed in melius, sed in subsidium veritatis, non detrimentum, non ut facile contra Do-ctorum , minus Ecclesiarum sententiam & consensum , ex temerario novandi pruritu, & quærendi nomen per devia

page.notes: The first word is a fragment carried over from the previous page ("stica", the long s read as s). The catchword "quod" is printed at the lower right. No page number is printed. Some letters in the scan are soft, notably "multum" and the accents, but they were read as printed.
